sentences.text: Symptosuchus is classified as a reptile.
Argentine paleontologist Florentino Ameghino named the genus Symptosuchus and its type species S. contortidens in 1899.
The genus Symptosuchus was formally described by Carlos Rusconi in 1934.
Symptosuchus belongs to the parent group Goniopholididae.
Symptosuchus is classified in the family Goniopholididae.
Symptosuchus fossils date to the Late Cretaceous period.
Symptosuchus was found in Argentina during the Late Cretaceous.
